unaids.title: UNAIDS — Let Communities Lead
unaids.challenge: UNAIDS needed an interactive campaign website to promote community-led responses to HIV. The site required rich animations, multilingual content management, and a design that could engage diverse audiences across devices while maintaining fast load times.
unaids.approach: I built the frontend using animated and interactive interfaces with Canvas and SVG, translating high-fidelity Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive layouts. Content was managed through Prismic CMS, allowing the UNAIDS team to update campaign content independently across multiple languages.
unaids.stack: Vue.js, Nuxt.js, TypeScript, Prismic CMS, Canvas/SVG animations, Figma/Zeplin, responsive design
unaids.outcome: The campaign site launched successfully, supporting UNAIDS global advocacy efforts. The interactive storytelling approach increased engagement, and the CMS-driven architecture enabled the team to maintain and update content without developer involvement.
contributions: Animated and interactive interfaces using Canvas and SVG for visual storytelling
Pixel-perfect implementation from Figma and Zeplin designs into responsive, cross-browser layouts
Dynamic multilingual content integration via Prismic CMS
Performance optimization for loading times and animations across devices
Collaboration with designers and backend teams to deliver on tight campaign deadlines
